content: Good morning, Sunrise Family Clinic, this is Ana. How can I help you today?
Good morning, Ana. Yes... could I book an appointment? I'd see a doctor, if possible.
Sure thing! Do you have a preferred doctor or a specific day in mind?
No, any doctor is fine. And, hmm, I haven't picked a day yet. Could you just tell me what's open?

We have Tuesday at ten thirty in the morning with Dr. Lopez or Tuesday at four thirty in the afternoon with Dr. Ruiz. Which would you prefer?That's perfect; may I have your full name to confirm?...May I have your full name to book the appointment?
Oh... er, hold on. I'm not sure yet. I should check my calendar before I decide. Let me think about this one.
Sure, take your time. Let me know whenever you’re ready to choose a slot.
Thank you. I think I'll call back once I've looked things over. Sorry to bother you, and good morning.
No bother at all. Have a great day, and we’ll be here whenever you’re ready.
